weakness: CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion: stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs
rationale: Used only by the Prisma CLI to merge its own configuration. It is not a dependency of @prisma/client (the runtime), is never imported by application code, and the production container starts with `node dist/server.js`, which never runs the CLI. The merged input is repository-controlled configuration, never request data, so an attacker cannot reach it.
fix: Upgrade to Prisma 7.10.1 or later. That is a major version (new config file and client generator) and changes all database access, so it is a planned migration, not a patch.
